description: Searches the 14,000+ CMS-certified nursing homes by name, city or state and returns each match's CCN, name, city, state, certified beds, CMS overall star rating, whether an FHA-insured HUD 232 loan is matched (active, past or none) and its SNF Register page. Use the CCN with get_nursing_home.

hud_loan.description: Only facilities with an active matched FHA loan, a past one only, or none. Default any.

min_stars.description: Only facilities with at least this CMS overall star rating.

query.description: Part of the facility name as CMS lists it, e.g. "Civic Center" or "Good Samaritan".

sort.description: name (A to Z, default) or beds (largest first).

state.description: US state, DC, PR or GU: two-letter code (e.g. TX) or full name (e.g. "Texas").

name: search_nursing_homes
title: Find CMS-certified nursing homes
